details: The broader crypto market experienced a 0.95% gain on July 18, fueled by increasing optimism around the CLARITY Act. This proposed legislation aims to provide regulatory clarity for digital assets by potentially classifying Ethereum and certain other tokens as commodities, which could reduce uncertainty for institutional investors. A potential Senate vote on the bill is anticipated between July 20-24.
title: CLARITY Act Optimism Boosts Crypto Market

details: T. Rowe Price has launched a new active spot crypto exchange-traded fund (ETF) that includes Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and XRP among its top holdings. This development marks another significant entry of traditional financial institutions into the cryptocurrency investment landscape, providing more avenues for institutional capital.
title: T. Rowe Price Debuts Active Spot Crypto ETF

details: In a shift from previous trends, Ethereum-based ETFs recorded substantial inflows of $1.6 billion last week, significantly outpacing Bitcoin ETFs, which experienced approximately $175 million in outflows. This indicates a growing and diversified institutional interest in Ethereum-specific investment products.
title: Ethereum ETFs Outpace Bitcoin Funds in Recent Inflows

details: Ethereum has seen significant whale activity, with $260 million in net inflows over the last 24 hours as large investors accumulated ETH around the $1,860 price level. Technical analysis, including a positive MACD and price consolidation above key moving averages, suggests that bullish momentum may be building for Ethereum.
title: Ethereum Whales Accumulate $260M, Hinting at Bullish Trend

details: Bitcoin is currently trading around the $64,600-$64,800 range. While a prediction market on July 18 indicated a 100% certainty of Bitcoin trading below $64,000 for that day, another prediction market on July 19 suggests a 74% probability of Bitcoin reaching $70,000 this year. This highlights a mixed short-term outlook versus a potentially bullish longer-term sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Price Shows Mixed Signals Amidst Market Predictions

details: The broader cryptocurrency market is experiencing a lack of consistent demand, despite recent inflation data indicating a slowdown. Investor caution persists due to the ongoing possibility of a more aggressive interest rate policy from the Federal Reserve, which could continue to limit appetite for risk assets like cryptocurrencies. The Crypto Fear and Greed Index remains in the "fear" zone at 32 points.
title: Crypto Demand Weakens Amid Fed Rate Hike Concerns

details: XRP has seen a significant 70% decline from its peak in July 2025 to its current trading price of $1.09. This drop occurred despite several positive developments for Ripple, including settling its SEC lawsuit, receiving conditional approval for a national trust bank charter, and XRP's classification as a commodity. The underperformance is attributed to prevailing bearish market sentiment and the continuous release of new XRP tokens without a substantial burn mechanism.
title: XRP Price Declines 70% Despite Ripple's Legal Wins
